lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.13 - A Listen, point, and say

details:
Listen, Point, and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound.
Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Sing: Happy birthday to me, happy birthday to...

“We are going to have a party. There are so many things to plan. We need food, games, music! Let's listen and find out what else we need to do."

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.13 - B. Listen and circle

details: Listen and Circle continues checking sound–image connections. Students listen for specific words or details, then show understanding by clearly circling the correct picture or number.
Look for careful listening, accurate choices, clear circling, and neat work in students’ books.
“I need some help! There's one thing we really, really need to do for the party. What do you think it could be? Music? Posters? Food? I don't know. Can you help me listen and find out?”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.69 - A Match & write

details: Match and write checks understanding of vocabulary by linking each word to the correct picture. This builds on key skills such as spelling, meaning and careful observation.
Look for accurate matching of words and pictures, neat and legible writing and the correct spelling.
“OK, now we know what we need, let's make a list in our books so we don't forget anything.”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.69 - B Look at A & write

details: Look at A and write builds writing accuracy as students use the model given in Activity A. This helps to develop spelling, word recognition and careful copying through reading and writing. Students use the pictures and the question to create sentences.
Look for the correct word choice, accurate spelling, clear handwriting and students using the phrases from Activity A to support their writing. Check that students are answering the question.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.14 - C. Ask and answer

details: Ask and answer gives students the opportunity to practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for use of question words (what, how, why etc.) and clear and appropriate answers. Ensure students are using the picture prompts to help them,
“Do you know what you’ll bring to the party? Will it be something to eat or something to do? Ask your friend what they are going to bring. Together, you can make sure you have everything you need!”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.14 - D. Plan a class party. Ask your friends to do different tasks

details: Planning a class party provides the opportunity for students to further develop speaking and cooperation skills by using the target language. It builds confidence and fluency.
Look for students using clear requests, responding appropriately, sharing tasks and using the word prompts given.
“I’m so excited! We are going to plan a class party. Let’s look at the tasks below and choose what we are all going to do. Do you want to bring the pizza or the games? Who wants to choose the music?”
